cashback_events_value_consistency_check.name: cashback_events_value_consistency_check
cashback_events_value_consistency_check.value: (("cashback_events"."value_type" = 'ESTIMADO' and "cashback_events"."transaction_id" is null and "cashback_events"."contabilizable" = 0) or ("cashback_events"."value_type" = 'REAL' and "cashback_events"."transaction_id" is not null and "cashback_events"."contabilizable" = 1))

import_batches_confirmed_audit_check.name: import_batches_confirmed_audit_check
import_batches_confirmed_audit_check.value: (("import_batches"."status" = 'CONFIRMED' and "import_batches"."confirmed_at" is not null and "import_batches"."confirmed_by" is not null and "import_batches"."confirmed_by" = "import_batches"."user_id") or ("import_batches"."status" <> 'CONFIRMED' and "import_batches"."confirmed_at" is null and "import_batches"."confirmed_by" is null))

transactions_voided_audit_check.name: transactions_voided_audit_check
transactions_voided_audit_check.value: (("transactions"."voided_at" is null and "transactions"."voided_by" is null) or ("transactions"."voided_at" is not null and "transactions"."voided_by" is not null and "transactions"."voided_by" = "transactions"."user_id"))
